SELECT rh.supplier_id AS supplierId, c.customer_code AS supplierCode, c.customer_name AS supplierName, c.business_no AS businessNo, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rh.receipt_dt BETWEEN CAST(#{receiptFrom} AS date) AND CAST(#{receiptTo} AS date)) AS receiptCount, COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(rd.closing_total_amt, rd.total_amt)) FILTER (WHERE rh.receipt_dt BETWEEN CAST(#{receiptFrom} AS date) AND CAST(#{receiptTo} AS date)), 0) AS receiptAmount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rd.closing_month = #{closingMonth}) AS monthClosedCount, COALESCE(sum(rd.closing_total_amt) FILTER (WHERE rd.closing_month = #{closingMonth}), 0) AS monthClosedAmount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rh.receipt_dt BETWEEN CAST(#{receiptFrom} AS date) AND CAST(#{receiptTo} AS date) AND rd.closing_month IS NULL) AS openCount FROM tb_purchase_receipt_hd rh JOIN tb_purchase_receipt_dt rd ON rd.purchase_receipt_id = rh.purchase_receipt_id AND rd.tenant_id = rh.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = rh.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = rh.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = rd.material_id AND m.tenant_id = rd.tenant_id WHERE rh.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND rh.use_at = 'Y' AND (rh.receipt_dt BETWEEN CAST(#{receiptFrom} AS date) AND CAST(#{receiptTo} AS date) OR rd.closing_month = #{closingMonth})
AND (m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
GROUP BY rh.supplier_id, c.customer_code, c.customer_name, c.business_no ORDER BY c.customer_name, rh.supplier_id

SELECT rh.purchase_receipt_id AS purchaseReceiptId, rd.purchase_receipt_detail_id AS purchaseReceiptDetailId, rh.receipt_no AS receiptNo, rh.receipt_dt AS receiptDt, rh.use_at AS useAt, rh.supplier_id AS supplierId, c.customer_name AS supplierName, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, oh.order_no AS orderNo, rd.inspection_no AS inspectionNo, rd.receipt_qty AS receiptQty, COALESCE(rd.closing_unit_price, rd.unit_price) AS unitPrice, COALESCE(rd.closing_tax_type, rh.tax_type) AS taxType, COALESCE(rd.closing_vat_included_at, rh.vat_included_at) AS vatIncludedAt, COALESCE(rd.closing_supply_amt, rd.supply_amt) AS supplyAmt, COALESCE(rd.closing_vat_amt, rd.vat_amt) AS vatAmt, COALESCE(rd.closing_total_amt, rd.total_amt) AS totalAmt, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, rd.remark AS remark, rd.closing_month AS closingMonth, rd.closed_at AS closedAt, rd.closed_by AS closedBy, (rd.closing_month IS NOT NULL) AS closed FROM tb_purchase_receipt_hd rh JOIN tb_purchase_receipt_dt rd ON rd.purchase_receipt_id = rh.purchase_receipt_id AND rd.tenant_id = rh.tenant_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_dt od ON od.purchase_order_detail_id = rd.purchase_order_detail_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_hd oh ON oh.purchase_order_id = od.purchase_order_id AND oh.tenant_id = od.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = rh.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = rh.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = rd.material_id AND m.tenant_id = rd.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = rd.warehouse_id WHERE rh.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND rh.use_at = 'Y'
AND rd.closing_month = #{closingMonth}
AND rh.receipt_dt BETWEEN CAST(#{receiptFrom} AS date) AND CAST(#{receiptTo} AS date)
AND rd.closing_month IS NULL
AND rh.supplier_id = #{supplierId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
AND oh.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{orderNo} || '%'
AND (m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY rd.closing_month NULLS FIRST, rh.receipt_dt, m.material_name, rh.receipt_no, rd.line_no
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_purchase_receipt_dt SET closing_month = #{closingMonth}, closed_at = now(), closed_by = #{closedBy}, closing_unit_price = #{unitPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, closing_tax_type = #{taxType}, closing_vat_included_at = #{vatIncludedAt}, closing_supply_amt = #{supplyAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, closing_vat_amt = #{vatAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, closing_total_amt = #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, updated_by = #{closedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_receipt_detail_id = #{purchaseReceiptDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND closing_month IS NULL

UPDATE tb_purchase_receipt_dt SET closing_month = NULL, closed_at = NULL, closed_by = NULL, closing_unit_price = NULL, closing_tax_type = NULL, closing_vat_included_at = NULL, closing_supply_amt = NULL, closing_vat_amt = NULL, closing_total_amt = NULL, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_receipt_detail_id = #{purchaseReceiptDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND closing_month IS NOT NULL
